description: Sprite animation pointer table discovered at ROM offset 0x53F200. 38 entries of u32 pointers to animation frame data.

fields.name: anim_ptr
fields.description: Pointer to animation frame data structure

fields.name: frame_ptr
fields.description: Pointer to sprite frame graphics data

fields.name: next_ptr
fields.description: Pointer to next animation frame (linked list)

notes: Sprite animation pointer table located just before the unit ID table (0x53F298). Entries come in pairs - odd entries have frame_count=1 (active frame with 0xFFFF flag), even entries have frame_count=0 (inactive/transition frame). Each animation frame is a 16-byte structure containing a pointer to graphics data and a linked-list pointer to the next frame. Located at 0x53F200, ends at 0x53F298 (where unit ID table begins).
verification_method: Static analysis - found 38 consecutive u32 pointers at 0x53F200, all pointing to valid ROM addresses in 0x12Fxxx region. Target data has consistent 16-byte structure with frame pointers and animation flags.
discovered_by: Examining region near unit ID table (0x53F298)
